description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of experts across layers, specifically examining groups G0, G1, and G2. The horizontal axis represents “Layer,” with categories labeled 1 through 24, arranged in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of Experts” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at integer values. Each layer is represented by a grouped set of three bars, denoting the number of experts within each of the three groups. The bars for G0 are teal, those for G1 are green, and those for G2 are yellow. For Layer 1, the G0 bar extends to approximately 4.7, the G1 bar to approximately 3.8, and the G2 bar reaches 8.3. Across all layers, the height of G2 bars consistently exceeds the heights of the G0 and G1 bars. In Layer 11, for instance, G0 extends to around 2.3, G1 to around 2.3, and G2 to approximately 3.7. The bars are not visually emphasized in any specific way, such as through shading or outlining.
